title: Implement a bounded feature
summary: Study the repository, implement the feature as traceable leaf tasks, and validate behavior plus automated coverage.

request_parts.text: Add the requested observable behavior without breaking the existing public contract.
Add deterministic automated coverage for the normal path and the main edge case.

repository_findings: The existing behavior is implemented under src/example.ext.
The repository test convention is represented by test/example_test.ext and the project test command.
request_analysis.research_decision: No external research is required because the relevant behavior and test conventions are fully defined by this repository.
assumptions: The public interface must remain backward compatible.
risks: An implementation-only change could miss the existing edge-case behavior.
request_analysis.decomposition_strategy: Separate the production behavior from its independently verifiable automated coverage while preserving a dependency from tests to the implemented contract.

requirements.text: Provide the requested observable behavior while preserving the existing public contract.
Add deterministic automated tests for the normal path and the main edge case.

notes: Confirmed that both request parts map to requirements and executable TODOs.
Confirmed that production behavior and automated coverage have separate validation boundaries.
Confirmed that no TODO is extreme and the dependency graph is acyclic.
Confirmed that the single global context item is required by both TODOs and that no scoped context file is justified.

tasks.title: Implement the core behavior
tasks.objective: Add the bounded production change that provides the requested behavior without changing the public contract.
tasks.atomicity_rationale: This leaf has one production outcome, a bounded implementation surface, and a direct behavior validation; automated coverage is a separate dependent outcome.

in: Core implementation and directly required local adjustments

implementation_guidance: Follow existing repository patterns and preserve compatibility
acceptance_criteria: The requested behavior is observable through the existing public interface.

tasks.title: Add automated coverage
tasks.objective: Add deterministic tests for the new behavior, compatibility expectation, and main edge case.
tasks.atomicity_rationale: This leaf owns one verification outcome and can be accepted independently by running the focused and full project test commands.

in: Focused automated tests and directly required fixtures

implementation_guidance: Cover success, compatibility, and the main edge case deterministically
acceptance_criteria: Focused tests prove the requested behavior and main edge case.
The full project test suite remains green.

global.rationale: Both implementation and automated-coverage TODOs must preserve the same public compatibility boundary and unrelated working-tree changes.

items.text: Preserve the existing public contract and unrelated working-tree changes in every TODO.
items.necessity: Both TODOs can affect or validate behavior through the public interface and operate in the same working tree.
